reviews.comment: A LOT OF TRICK QUESTIONS. The exams don't match the lecture slides and this isn't an easy class. Your grade is reliant on your exams. I wouldn't recommend taking this professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The course was great and very interesting, and Dr. Gomez was very engaging which made it easy to follow. Your grade comes from a mix of different types of assignments so it is a great history to take no matter what your strengths are!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Gomez is an extremely entertaining prof and can make history interesting for nearly anyone. Attend lecture as not all the information is present on the slides.

Lectures were engaging and interesting. The class was graded on 4 exams, which were very fair and easy to get an A on if you studied well and paid attention. Most of the info comes from what he says in the lectures, rather than what's on the slides, so going to class is important.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took him for Sea Power, lectures are important as everything said is on the exams. Read one book and wrote an essay over it, super easy just do not procrastinate. Overall easy A, show up pay attention and read the books. Would recommend it as an alternative to a boring history. Definitely a great class and Professor!

Because of his entertaining lectures, this class is the only class I actually look forward to going to. Prof Gomez makes can make basically anything interesting and is very easy to listen to. 2 tests and an essay over a book, the test are relatively easy but you must go to class in order to get all the information. Best prof I've had so far.

Professor Gomez was a funny and chill prof. I took him for History of American Sea Power, and for my first college level history, he made a great impression. He made us buy three books, two of which I dont use at all, and the third you have to write an essay over. His tests are basically all regarding the lecture, so take good notes.

Mr. Gomez was awesome! His lectures were super informative and interesting. We had 3 tests including the final, which was not cumulative. Go to class, take notes, and buy the primary source textbook (it's like $10), and you should get an A!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This guy is awesome! Incredible and insightful lectures that had me on the edge of my seat. Literally, just go to class take some notes and you'll get an A. No need to buy the textbook just buy the primary source pamphlet. Take notes on the overarching themes and not minute details such as names/dates. Super cool and funny prof. Only 3 tests.

Clemente is an incredible lecturer and I learned a ton about history and never got bored while he was talking. His lectures are extremely captivating. The only grades are the 3 exams. He does not post any class notes so you have to go to lecture otherwise you will be completely lost on the exam. The exam is basically 100% lecture.

Incredible and engaging lectures. Only 3 exams. No homework. Go to class. Take good and thorough notes. Dont buy the textbook! Get the primary source pamphlet. Study a few days before class. Youll do good if you do all of these things. Take him, its a relatively easy class, good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Gomez is an outstanding lecturer. Only 4 exams, all lecture based so you kinda have to go to class, but his lectures are so interesting and captivating (I never missed a day of class). You can clearly see his passion. He is clearly knowledgeable in his field as we would give specific answers to any questions. Would 100% take him again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Clemente is a fantastic lecturer. He can literally speak for the whole class without once saying "um..." He is very knowledgeable, funny, and he always gives very detailed answers to questions. He gets about 90 to 95% of his exam questions from his lectures, so YOU MUST GO TO CLASS if you want to pass.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Only 4 exams total and are all lecture based, you can still pass with at least a B if you dont buy the textbook. I bought it and i wish i didnt cause i used it like 2 times and his exams were all based on lecture notes. Super easy tbh. Prof Clemente is pretty cool too.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Mr. Gomez for HIST 103 and he's by far one of the best history professors I've had. He does his best to keep lectures interesting. He can move a bit fast at time, but as long as you go to lectures and take notes you should be fine on the tests. He also doesn't assign homework, the final grade is equally split between your 4 exams. Recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amazing World History teacher. As long as you come to class and listen to the lectures and take notes you will be fine on the tests. There are weekly quizzes from readings but they are super simple and were open note. You can tell he cares about what he is teaching and loves to help people.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures
